name: Glass spreadsheet fill
oneLiner: a spreadsheet on a glass pane: the selection walks down the column filling each cell, a SUM formula types into the formula bar with marching ants round the range, and the column total counts up and lands
say: when the speaker adds things up or shows their numbers ('here is what each channel brought in', 'add it all up'): the cells fill as they list them, the total lands on the sum
